Are you an electrician and do you know everything there is to know about wiring? Do you enjoy contributing to the construction of ships or installing and optimising the electrical networks of buildings? Then this vacancy is for you. 

What will you be doing? 
You are in the right place as an electrician. You can make a difference at various work locations with your electrical engineering knowledge and skills. One moment you may be working on building a luxury yacht, and the next you may be connecting the entire electrical network of a cruise ship. 
You may also find yourself in a place where the entire electrical system of a chalet or house needs to be installed. In addition, there is the possibility of being asked to solve electrical problems within mechanical engineering or existing buildings and schools. 
•    Working as an electrician at DB Work at various locations.
•    Applying your electrical engineering knowledge and skills to various projects.
•    Building luxury passenger yachts.
•    Connecting the entire electrical network of a cruise ship.
•    Installing electrical systems in chalets or homes.
•    Resolving electrical faults and problems within mechanical engineering.
•    Maintaining and repairing electrical systems in existing buildings and schools.

Who are you?
You are an enthusiastic electrician with a passion for your profession. You have knowledge of electrical engineering, gained through education or work experience, and you enjoy contributing your technical skills to a wide range of projects. In addition, you are motivated to live and work in the Netherlands and want to continue developing yourself within the field of electrical engineering.
You also recognize yourself in the following:
•    You have knowledge of electrical engineering through education or work experience.
•    You are eager to learn, enthusiastic and embrace new challenges.
•    You can work independently but also function well within a team.
•    You work accurately and safely with electrical installations.
•    You are motivated to live and work in the Netherlands.
•    You want to continue to develop yourself within the field.
•    You can communicate effectively in English.

jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422
